subtitle: Cross-reference for 22 August 2026: Polymarket price at reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC), presidential book at USD 131.16M, against the 21/Aug Datafolha poll (n=2,058, fieldwork 18 to 20/Aug, reliability 5) and the 21/Aug Veritá poll (n=3,840, fieldwork 16 to 20/Aug, reliability 2), which are the two most recent national polls with a published number. Five other national polls are registered with the TSE for release between 24 and 27 August and have no number yet.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 62.50% (vol USD 8.86M cumulative), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC). No change on the day.
fortes: The 21/Aug Datafolha poll (n=2,058, fieldwork 18 to 20/Aug, reliability 5, BR-04496/2026) puts him at 39% in the first round and has him winning the runoff 47% to 43% against Flávio Bolsonaro.
On price he remains far ahead: 62.50% against 33.35%, a distance of 29.15pp, with his contract holding USD 8.86M inside a presidential book of USD 131.16M.
The price did not move today, after losing 1.00pp in yesterday’s reading. Holding steady on a day when the runner-up set the highest point of the series is a result in his favour, not against him.
In the first-round second-place contract he shows only 6.20%, which is consistent with a market that sees him finishing first.
In the 83-day series beginning 31/May, his floor is 39.50%, measured on 02/Jun. Today’s price sits 23 points above that floor.
fracos: ⛔ No upside superlative applies: the peak of the 83-day series is 66.50%, set on 16/Aug, and today’s price is 4.00pp below it.

The 21/Aug Veritá poll (n=3,840, fieldwork 16 to 20/Aug, reliability 2, BR-04006/2026) contradicts Datafolha on the runoff and gives the win to Flávio Bolsonaro. Two national polls from the same day, with overlapping fieldwork, pointing opposite ways.
The runner-up set the highest point of the 83-day series today. The distance between the two goes from 30.45pp on 21/Aug to 29.15pp now.
Five national polls are registered with the TSE for release between 24 and 27/Aug, one of them with a sample of 6,000. None has a published number, so the polling picture can change within five days.
Today’s press reading is entirely follow-up on yesterday’s Datafolha, with 164 distinct headlines in the collection. There was no new fact to support a price move in his favour.
candidates.analise:
PRICE at 62.50% (vol USD 8.86M cumulative), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC), unchanged on the day. The distance to the runner-up stands at 29.15pp, against 30.45pp in yesterday’s reading.

In the 83-day series that begins on 31 May, his peak is 66.50%, from 16 August, and his floor is 39.50%, from 02 June. Today’s price sits four points below his own peak, so no upside superlative is available.

In the polls, the 21 August Datafolha gives him 39% in the first round and a runoff win of 47% to 43%. The Veritá of the same day, with a larger sample and overlapping fieldwork, inverts the runoff. Both remain the most recent national polls with a published number, and they disagree.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 33.35% (vol USD 8.78M cumulative), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC). Down 0.10pp on the day, after today’s highest recorded point, 33.80%, set the highest value of the 83-day series.
fortes: ⭐ Today’s highest recorded point, 33.80%, is the highest of the 83-day series beginning 31/May. The floor of that same series is 22.00%, from 03/Jul: 11.80pp of advance in under two months.
The 21/Aug Veritá poll (n=3,840, reliability 2) has him winning the runoff, which no national poll had done before it.
The 21/Aug Datafolha, the more reliable of the two, shows the runoff at 47% to 43%, a four-point gap that falls within statistical-tie range given the stated margin.
In the first-round second-place contract he holds 84.50%, meaning the market treats his advance as all but settled.
The Partido Liberal holds 78.50% in the largest-Senate-bloc market, with vol USD 0.26M, giving party context to his presidential price.
fracos: The live late-afternoon price, 33.35%, sits 0.45pp below today’s highest recorded point. The day set the series peak and gave part of it back.
The distance to the leader remains 29.15pp, and his price is close to half of Lula’s.
⛔ The superlative here is about the SERIES, not the cycle: the ruler starts on 31/May and covers 83 days. There is no basis to say "the highest ever".
Datafolha gives him 33% in the first round against Lula’s 39%, a six-point gap that Veritá measures differently. The two houses disagree about him more than about any other name.
Five national polls registered with the TSE are due between 24 and 27/Aug and have no number yet. The picture underpinning his price can change within five days.
candidates.analise:
PRICE at 33.35% (vol USD 8.78M cumulative), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC), down 0.10pp on the day.

⭐ The number of the day is another one: today’s highest recorded point, 33.80%, is the highest of the 83-day series that begins on 31 May. On 03 July the same contract paid 22.00%.

The distance to the leader stands at 29.15pp, against 30.45pp yesterday. In the polls, the 21 August Datafolha gives him 33% in the first round and 43% in the runoff, and the Veritá of the same day has him winning the runoff. He is the name the two houses disagree about most.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 2.65% (vol USD 10.56M cumulative), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC). Down 1.50pp on the day, the largest drop in the presidential book.
fortes: In the first-round third-place contract he stays ahead, with 49.50% against 46.00% for Ronaldo Caiado, a 3.50pp difference.
His contract holds USD 10.56M, one of the largest individual volumes in the presidential book, above Lula’s and Flávio Bolsonaro’s.
The 21/Aug Datafolha puts him at 4% and Veritá at 3.8%, meaning both houses measure him at a similar level, which is not the case for several other names.
In the first-round second-place contract he holds 3.55%, with vol USD 1.14M, the third-highest value in that market.
fracos: 🔴 DOWN 1.50pp on the day, the largest drop in the presidential book. The price went from 4.15% to 2.65%.
🔴 Today’s lowest recorded point, 3.40%, is the LOWEST of the 83-day series beginning 31/May. The peak of that same series is 17.90%, from 09/Jun: today’s price is under a fifth of that value.
The live price, 2.65%, sits below even the lowest point recorded during the day, which suggests the fall had not settled by late afternoon.
He is the name with the largest individual volume among those that lost price today. High volume with a falling price means the money that came in did not hold the value.
His lead in the third-place contract, 3.50pp over Caiado, is narrower than the gap between the two in the presidential market, which leaves the position exposed.
candidates.analise:
PRICE at 2.65% (vol USD 10.56M cumulative), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC), DOWN 1.50pp on the day, the largest drop in the presidential book.

🔴 Today’s lowest recorded point, 3.40%, is the lowest of the 83-day series that begins on 31 May. On 09 June the same contract paid 17.90%.

The contrast with volume is what gives the move its weight: he holds USD 10.56M, one of the largest in the book, above Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. In the first-round third-place contract he is still ahead, 49.50% against 46.00% for Ronaldo Caiado, but by only 3.50pp.

In the polls the picture is stable: 4% in the 21 August Datafolha and 3.8% in the Veritá of the same day.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE for the whole trailing pack, reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC): Ronaldo Caiado 0.35% (vol USD 6.44M), Romeu Zema 0.15% (vol USD 5.83M), Pablo Marçal 0.15% (vol USD 2.34M), Michelle Bolsonaro 0.15% (vol USD 10.11M) and Tarcísio de Freitas 0.05% (vol USD 14.00M).
candidates.subtitle: Aug 20, fifth day of the campaign: the pack's move was all DOWNWARD in the price of victory, and the name that moved most was the one that just entered the race.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), presidential Poly 0.35% (vol USD 6.43M accumulated, confirmed reading of Aug 21, 9:02 PM BRT (Aug 22, 12:02 AM UTC)), up 0.10pp | first round third place at 35.00% | ⚠️ below the 0.5% cutoff the double reading watches | ballot in force: Veritá of Aug 21 with 3.3% in the first round, behind Marçal and Renan Santos
caiado.fortes: ⭐ His THIRD-PLACE contract stands at 37.50%, against 31.00% at the Aug 12 close, a 6.50pp rise with four straight higher closes. In other words, the market moved him closer on PLACING while moving him away from VICTORY. In the polling he still has 4% in the Quaest of Aug 14 and the lowest rejection in the field, 35%. He opened the campaign with a mass at the Goiânia cathedral and a motorcade through Goiás and the Federal District outskirts, according to Folha de S.Paulo and G1, and said the United States does not rule Brazil, according to Times Brasil.
caiado.fracos: In the victory price he fell 0.45pp and moved to 0.60%, brushing the 0.5% cutoff. ⚠️ The 35% rejection comes with high name-recognition gaps declared by the house itself, and low rejection with high unfamiliarity is not acceptance: it means most of the electorate has not yet formed an opinion, and an unformed opinion can go either way. His contrast remains the widest on the panel, with 4% to 5.7% of declared intention against less than 1% of victory price.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), presidential Poly 0.05% (vol USD 7.28M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 21, 9:02 PM BRT (Aug 22, 12:02 AM UTC), below the 0.5% cutoff | no national poll tests him for president
haddad.fortes: His cumulative volume remains larger than that of several names priced above him, which keeps the contract with trading depth despite the floor-level price. He spoke at the president's campaign-opening rally in the ABC region, according to O Globo.
haddad.fracos: ⭐ The caveat the panel had been repeating as an inference became a DATED FACT on Aug 16: he formally opened a campaign for the GOVERNORSHIP OF SÃO PAULO, according to O Globo and Times Brasil. That is, he is not a presidential candidate, and any presidential scenario that includes him is a polling hypothesis, not a candidacy under way. No national poll in the window tests him. The price fell to 0.05%, and variation in that band carries no informational value.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), presidential Poly 0.15% (vol USD 5.81M accumulated, confirmed reading of Aug 21, 9:02 PM BRT (Aug 22, 12:02 AM UTC)), unchanged and below the 0.5% cutoff | first round third place at 4.90% | ballot in force: Veritá of Aug 21 with 1.3% in the first round
zema.fortes: The Quaest of Aug 14 keeps him at 2% in the first round, the same value as Aug 5, and BTG/Nexus's 3% and Meio/Ideia's 2.6% still stand. He was the first of the chasing pack to file with the electoral court, on Aug 6. He opened the campaign with a mass in Montes Claros, in northern Minas Gerais, promising a maximum-security prison and criticising Supreme Court justices, according to Folha de S.Paulo and Valor Econômico.
zema.fracos: 🔴 The Quaest firmness crosstab released on Aug 15 shows he has the LEAST CONVINCED electorate in the field, according to G1, which speaks to how solid his support is rather than how large. In the price he fell 0.20pp and moved to 0.15%, below the 0.5% cutoff. In the third-place contract he has 5.00%, far behind the 53.00% of the chasing pack's leader.

candidates.analise:
PRICE for the pack at the reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC): Ronaldo Caiado 0.35% (vol USD 6.44M), Romeu Zema 0.15% (vol USD 5.83M), Pablo Marçal 0.15% (vol USD 2.34M), Michelle Bolsonaro 0.15% (vol USD 10.11M) and Tarcísio de Freitas 0.05% (vol USD 14.00M). None moved today.

The contrast worth recording is between volume and price. Tarcísio de Freitas holds the largest individual volume in the presidential book, USD 14.00M, and is priced at 0.05%. Michelle Bolsonaro holds USD 10.11M at 0.15%. Cumulative volume measures how much money has passed through the contract since it opened, not the probability the market assigns today, and these two cases show the difference plainly.

Caiado is the only one in the pack with a meaningful position in another market: 46.00% in the first-round third-place contract, 3.50pp behind Renan Santos.
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado holds 46.00% in the first-round third-place contract, 3.50pp behind Renan Santos, despite sitting at 0.35% in the presidential market. The two markets tell different stories about him.
The 21/Aug Datafolha gives him 5% in the first round, ahead of Renan Santos, who shows 4%.
Tarcísio de Freitas holds USD 14.00M, the LARGEST individual volume in the presidential book, even priced at 0.05%. High volume with a low price measures interest, not probability.
Michelle Bolsonaro holds USD 10.11M at 0.15%, another case of large volume with a minimal price.
fracos: All below the 0.5% floor of the capture guard, except by a narrow margin. Names in that range enter as a record and not as a signal, because a thin book swings without the race changing.
Romeu Zema had 3% in the 21/Aug Datafolha and sits at 0.15% on price, a gap between poll and market that no other name in the pack shows at that size.
The 21/Aug Veritá gives Caiado 3.3%, below Datafolha’s 5%. The two houses disagree about the trailing pack as much as about the front-runners.
Pablo Marçal shows 2% in Datafolha and 5.2% in Veritá, and his price is 0.15%. It is the widest split between the two polls within the pack.

quadroComparativo.p: ⭐⭐ TWO NATIONAL POLLS ON THE SAME DAY. The Datafolha (n=2,058, field Aug 18 to 20, reliability 5) gives him 39% in the first round and 47% in the runoff, against 43%. The Veritá (n=3,840, field Aug 16 to 20, reliability 2) also gives him 39.3% in the first round, but measures a 0.2 point TIE and INVERTS the runoff, with him at 42% against 47.3%. The two agree about him and disagree about the distance.
quadroComparativo.m: 62.50% (vol USD 8.86M), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC). No change from yesterday's reading. In the 83-day series that begins on 31 May, his peak is 66.50%, measured on 16 August, and his floor is 39.50%, from 02 June.
quadroComparativo.t: flat on the day, four points below the series peak
quadroComparativo.s: Fifth day of the official campaign, 45 days out from the first round. The case involving his son gained two layers on Aug 20: the Prosecutor General's Office contested part of the Federal Police's conclusion, according to Estadão, and he sued his opponent over a video made with artificial intelligence, according to O Globo.

quadroComparativo.p: ⭐⭐ TWO NATIONAL POLLS ON THE SAME DAY, AND HE IS WHERE THEY DISAGREE. The Datafolha gives him 32% in the scenario with Marçal and 33% without him, and 43% in the runoff against 47%. The Veritá gives him 39.1% in the first round, 0.2 point from the leader, and 47.3% in the runoff against 42%. More than 6 points of difference in the first round and more than 9 in the runoff, with overlapping fieldwork.
quadroComparativo.m: 33.35% (vol USD 8.78M), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC). Down 0.10pp on the day. Today's highest recorded point, 33.80%, is the highest of the 83-day series that began on 31 May, above the 22.00% low of 03 July.
quadroComparativo.t: at the highest point of the 83-day series
quadroComparativo.s: He praised Pablo Marçal as "a good guy, prepared and well-intentioned", according to Estadão on Aug 20, on the same day the Public Prosecutor's Office asked the TSE to bar the other man's candidacy. And he said he looks at the Supreme Court "with disgust", talking about being a transition president, according to Folha.

quadroComparativo.p: ⭐⭐ TWO NATIONAL POLLS ON THE SAME DAY, and both put him at the back of the field: 4% at Datafolha and 3.8% at Veritá. The Datafolha places him behind Ronaldo Caiado, who has 5%; the Veritá places him ahead of Caiado, who has 3.3%, and behind Pablo Marçal, who has 5.2%.
quadroComparativo.m: 2.65% (vol USD 10.56M), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC). Down 1.50pp on the day, the largest drop in the book. Today's lowest recorded point, 3.40%, is the lowest of the 83-day series, against 17.90% on 09 June. He still carries one of the largest individual volumes in the book.
quadroComparativo.t: at the lowest point of the 83-day series
quadroComparativo.s: 📌 The disagreement over third place changed shape and did not disappear. The market pays 55.50% on him against 35.00% on Caiado, and the Veritá of Aug 21 puts both BEHIND Pablo Marçal, who has 5.2% against his 3.8% and Caiado's 3.3%. Price and ballot still disagree on who is third, now with a third name in the count.

quadroComparativo.p: ⭐⭐ TWO NATIONAL POLLS ON THE SAME DAY, and they disagree about him: 5% at Datafolha, which keeps him ahead of Renan Santos, and 3.3% at Veritá, which puts him behind Renan and Marçal.
quadroComparativo.m: 0.35% (vol USD 6.44M), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC). No change. Below the 0.5% floor of the capture guard, so his price is not watched by the two-reading confirmation and enters here only as a record.
quadroComparativo.s: The inversion between the two instruments continues, with the sign flipped from last week: at the ballot he fell from 5% to 3.3% and now sits behind Renan Santos and Marçal, while in the third place contract his price ROSE to 35.00%.

quadroComparativo.p: ⭐⭐ MEASURED BY BOTH NATIONAL POLLS OF THE DAY, WITH DIFFERENT RESULTS: 2% at Datafolha, in the scenario with him, and 5.2% at Veritá. The Datafolha carries two scenarios and the difference between them is him: with Marçal, the runner-up has 32%; without Marçal, 33%.
quadroComparativo.m: 0.15% (vol USD 2.34M), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC). No change. Below the 0.5% floor of the capture guard.
quadroComparativo.s: 🔴 THE WIDEST DISTANCE BETWEEN THE PANEL'S TWO INSTRUMENTS IS ON HIM. The ballot puts him third at 5.2% and the price puts him seventh at 0.15%. ⛔ The two quantities do not subtract, because voting intention and probability of winning measure different things, and his price sits below the floor the double reading confirms. What the panel records is the opposite ordering, not a difference figure. Beyond that, the legal squeeze of Aug 19 and 20 remains unresolved.

quadroComparativo.p: No poll. Market on the impeachment of a Supreme Court justice before 2027.
quadroComparativo.m: 3.35% (vol USD 84k), reading confirmed at 22/Aug, 4:40pm BRT (7:40pm UTC). No change.
quadroComparativo.s: Contract on the impeachment of a Supreme Court justice before 2027, kept on the panel as an institutional thermometer. On Aug 20 Justice André Mendonça ruled on both sides of the race, at the Supreme Court and at the Electoral Court, and the contract did not move because of it.

cruzamento:
The day has a single movement, and it is a big one: Renan Santos fell 1.50pp and closed at 2.65%, the largest drop in the presidential book. In the 83-day series that starts on 31 May, the lowest point ever recorded for him is today's. On 09 June the same contract paid 17.90%.

In the opposite direction, Flávio Bolsonaro's highest recorded point today, 33.80%, is the highest of that same 83-day series. The live price in the late afternoon eased back to 33.35%, ten hundredths below yesterday, but the day's mark stands on the record. Lula did not move: 62.50%, the same as yesterday, and four points below the 66.50% peak he set on 16 August. The distance between the top two stands at 29.15pp.

The third-place contract is where Renan's fall shows up in another guise: he holds 49.50% and Ronaldo Caiado holds 46.00%, a 3.50pp difference between two names separated by 2.30pp in the presidential market. The same market that took price away from Renan in the main race still keeps him ahead in the race for third, and by a narrow margin.

On the polling side there is no new number. The 21 August Datafolha and the Veritá of the same day remain the two most recent published national polls, and they disagree: Datafolha gives Lula 39% and Flávio 33% in the first round, with Lula winning the runoff 47% to 43%; Veritá inverts the runoff. Five national polls are registered with the TSE for release between 24 and 27 August, among them the PoderData registered today and JOTA Jornalismo with a sample of 6,000. TSE registration is mandatory and precedes release, so none of them has a number yet.

What the press did today was follow up on yesterday's Datafolha, with 164 distinct headlines in the day's collection. There was no new market fact and no national poll published.
